notes.title: TAG Police Sentri V0.4.0
notes.notes:
The game name is now TAG Police Sentri! This version contains some new contents and updates:
- Winter theme UI and background
- New characters and maps
- Randomized map for public match
- Minor improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Updates V0.3.8
notes.notes:
- Ended Merdeka event
- Added bot in game
- Enable Halloween map decoration
- Bugs fixing and improvements

notes.title: Police Sentri V0.3.7

We are celebrating Malaysia's Independence Day in this update!
Changelogs:
1. Updated UI for Merdeka (Malaysia's Independent day)
2. Visit Police Sentri FB page for free character code redeem

notes.title: Police Sentri V0.3.6
notes.notes:
New update with improvements in the look of the game, more streamlined matchmaking system, and bug fixes:
- Improve game UI and matchmaking experience
- Fixed android login problem
- Fixed sudden game crash issue

notes.title: V0.3.4 Quickfix
notes.notes:
V0.3.4
- Fixed endgame score not calculating team victory point.
- Fixed game does not end when police/robber suppose to win
- Fixed Light on player in map mansion not enabled
- Fixed loading loops
- Fixed player card showing wrong platform (Visual bug)
- Fixed mistext on reset login button (previously shown "Register" instead "Reset")
- Readjust animation on start menu

notes.notes:

notes.title: Big update for Halloween!
notes.notes:
- 8 new characters. Some characters are only available during our Halloween event.
- 5 new creepy buddies to accompany you.
- 1 new midnight map, Mansion.
- Voice chat (BETA). Communicate with other players with our new build-in voice chat.
- Improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Update V0.2.9
notes.notes:
- Added new map : Forest.
- Added two new characters : Binjai (Police) & Gotosan (Robber).

- Added How To Play window for beginners.
- Fix some bugs and performance.

*Some translation may not properly/haven't translated. Please wait for more updates coming soon.
